description: This file implements dummy classes and factory functions for the split6_o_du_low plugin, including various notifier and adaptor classes used in the FAPI (FAPI operation controller, error notifier, P7 indications, P5 responses, and sector adaptors). It provides stub implementations for testing or placeholder purposes within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: operation_controller_dummy
classes.description: Dummy implementation of fapi_adaptor::operation_controller with empty start and stop methods.

classes.name: error_indication_notifier_dummy
classes.description: Dummy implementation of fapi::error_indication_notifier with empty on_error_indication method.

classes.name: p7_indications_notifier_dummy
classes.description: Dummy implementation of fapi::p7_indications_notifier with empty indication methods for rx data, CRC, UCI, SRS, RACH.

classes.name: p7_slot_indication_notifier_dummy
classes.description: Dummy implementation of fapi::p7_slot_indication_notifier with empty on_slot_indication method.

classes.name: mac_fapi_p7_sector_adaptor_dummy
classes.description: Dummy implementation of fapi_adaptor::mac_fapi_p7_sector_adaptor returning references to dummy notifiers.

classes.name: mac_fapi_p7_sector_adaptor_factory_dummy
classes.description: Factory dummy creating instances of mac_fapi_p7_sector_adaptor_dummy.

classes.name: p5_notifier_dummy
classes.description: Dummy implementation of fapi::p5_responses_notifier with empty response methods.

classes.name: mac_fapi_p5_sector_adaptor_dummy
classes.description: Dummy implementation of fapi_adaptor::mac_fapi_p5_sector_adaptor returning references to dummy notifiers and controller.

methods.name: split6_o_du_low_plugin_dummy::create_fapi_p5_sector_adaptor
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a dummy P5 sector adaptor.

methods.name: split6_o_du_low_plugin_dummy::create_fapi_p7_sector_adaptor_factory
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a dummy P7 sector adaptor factory.

methods.name: ocudu::create_split6_o_du_low_plugin
methods.description: Creates and returns a unique pointer to a dummy split6_o_du_low_plugin instance.
